item.title: 百樂達斯獲反貪腐及合規管理系統國際認證 外國人專用賭場首例
item.description:
>
百樂達斯取得反貪腐管理系統(ISO 37001)及合規管理系統(ISO 37301)兩項國際標準的整合認證。(百樂達斯圖片) 南韓外國人專用賭場營運商百樂達斯(Paradise Co. Ltd.)本月17日宣佈，取得反貪腐管理系統(ISO 37001)及合規管理系統(ISO 37301)兩項國際標準的整合認證，成為南韓外國人專用賭場業界首家取得上述整合認證的企業。 據百樂達斯近日公佈的資料，相關認證由韓國合規認證院頒發，代表公司建立的反貪腐及合規管理制度符合國際標準化組織(ISO)的相關要求。 ISO 37001主要針對企業內部貪腐風險的預防及管理，而ISO 37301則着重企業遵守相關法規及內部規章的管理制度。 為取得認證，百樂達斯在總部及旗下所有營運場所建立統一管理體系，包括制定反貪腐及合規管理政策、評估各業務環節的風險、檢查法規遵循情況，以及完善相關風險評估及管理程序；公司亦調整內部規章及業務流程，並透過員工培訓、內部審核及持續改善措施，加強企業整體的道德及合規管理制度。 百樂達斯指出，取得兩項國際標準的整合認證，有助提升企業管治透明度，進一步落實環境、社會及企業管治(ESG)相關措施，並增強客戶、合作夥伴及投資者等持份者的信任。 公司行政總裁崔鍾煥表示：「公司未來將繼續推動透明及負責任的企業管理，讓守法文化在整個組織內扎根，致力發展成為獲各方持份者信任的可持續企業。」 百樂達斯表示，未來將持續完善貪腐及違規風險的預防與管理機制，並提高員工的守法意識，以進一步加強企業的ESG管理及管治水平。

item.title: 永利捐款70萬支持公益金百萬行 組織1400人團隊齊步同行
item.description:
>
永利向澳門日報讀者公益基金會捐贈善款70萬元。 永利澳門一直心繫澳門社區，多年來積極投身公益，致力回饋社會。今年永利捐贈70萬澳門元支持「公益金百萬行」，並將組織逾千名團隊成員及家屬參與12月13日舉行百萬行活動。適逢永利扎根澳門20周年，參加者當日更會穿上特別設計的20周年紀念運動服，與澳門市民一同為公益邁步。 捐贈儀式今日(24日)於永利皇宮舉行。永利澳門總裁、董事會副主席兼執行董事陳志玲、營運總裁兼執行董事羅偉信、永利澳門及永利皇宮人力資源高級副總裁蘇家雯、永利澳門及永利皇宮社區及政府關係副總裁張詩敏，代表永利將善款支票交予澳門日報讀者公益基金會，並由會長賀定一、副會長陸波、飛安達、許建章、理事長黃國勝、常務副理事長何凱玲、鄺鍵濠及監事長邱金海代表接收。 賀定一衷心感謝永利澳門長期支持公益基金會。她表示，基金會一直秉承「人人為我，我為人人」的創會宗旨，以及「取之於民、用之於民、善款善用」的原則，積極開展慈善公益工作，關顧弱勢社群。基金會將繼續匯聚社會力量，加強社區支援，促進社會和諧共融。 陳志玲表示，公益金百萬行多年來匯聚社會各界的善心與支持，永利很高興能夠長期參與其中。今年適逢永利扎根澳門二十周年，能夠與1,400名已報名的團隊成員及其家人，聯同社會各界一起參與百萬行，延續多年來對社區公益的支持，亦讓這個重要里程碑更添意義。陳志玲指出，企業的發展離不開社區的和諧，永利將與各界攜手發揚守望相助的精神，為建設更加和諧共融的澳門貢獻力量。

item.title: Ng Wai Han: Market-Driven Guidance Fund to Boost “1+4” Diversification
item.description:
>
Ng Wai Han: Market-Driven Guidance Fund to Boost "1+4" Diversification Macao’s Secretary for Economy and Finance, Ng Wai Han, attended a plenary session of the Legislative Assembly on Monday (23 November) for the first time in her capacity as Secretary to debate next year’s economic and financial policy guidelines with lawmakers. Addressing key issues such as appropriate economic diversification, gross gaming revenue (GGR) trends, and support for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), Ng emphasized that the authorities will focus on the “1+4” industrial development strategy, striving to increase to 60 percent the non-gaming sector’s contribution to Macao’s total economy by 2030. She also pledged strict oversight of the six gaming concessionaires to ensure lawful and compliant operations, warning that any cutthroat competition practice involving raised commissions to poach customers will be dealt with strictly. Pushing “1+4” Diversification Through a Market-Operated Government Guidance Fund During the policy debate, lawmaker Si Ka Lon raised concerns regarding the high-quality implementation of non-gaming projects and the proportion of gaming versus non-gaming sectors in the overall economy. In response, Ng stated that advancing appropriate economic diversification is the only path to maintaining Macao’s long-term prosperity and stability. Under the SAR Government’s Third Five-Year Plan, the target for the non-gaming sector to account for 60 percent of the economy by 2030 does not mean shrinking the total volume of the gaming sector, but rather achieving the goal through the simultaneous growth of both gaming and non-gaming businesses. The government will adhere to combining an “efficient market” with a “capable government,” leveraging initiatives in MICE (meetings, incentives, conferences, and exhibitions) and commerce, modern finance, and technology R&D industrial parks to optimize the business environment. Ng noted that next year, the government will give full play to the leading role of the Macao Government Guidance Fund, focusing on attracting “chain-leader” enterprises with strong market appeal to settle in Macao and Hengqin. It will also bring in high-quality fund managers and venture capital to provide equity financing for emerging industries characterized by high initial investments and long return cycles. She stressed that investment decisions for the guidance fund are not made by government departments, but are operated by professionals through market-oriented mechanisms. Furthermore, a strict regulatory framework is already in place under existing administrative regulations; all projects must undergo due diligence, research evaluations, and tiered approvals before funds are deployed, ensuring public money is never used arbitrarily by the market. Analyzing GGR Trends and Shifting Consumption Patterns; Cracking Down on Commission “Involution” In light of Macao’s GGR recording five consecutive months of year-on-year declines recently, lawmakers Leong Sun Iok and Ho King Lun expressed concern over GGR prospects, the expansion of foreign visitor markets, and the fulfillment of gaming operators’ investment commitments. Ng explained that although overall visitor arrivals have not declined, GGR performance has been affected by base effects and shifting consumption patterns. GGR recorded growth from January to May this year due to a low base last year; saw more pronounced drops in June and July impacted by the World Cup; narrowed its decline in August and September; and fell year-on-year in October against a high base of over MOP 24 billion recorded in the same month last year. Nevertheless, cumulative GGR for the first 10 months of this year still registered a slight increase, showing a steady overall trend. She further pointed out that visitor spending habits have reversed in recent years. Taking a budget of MOP 1,000 as an example, visitors previously spent roughly MOP 600 on gaming and MOP 400 on non-gaming activities, whereas the ratio has now flipped. Visitors are increasingly inclined to explore local neighborhoods and experience diverse tourism products, reflecting their independent choices. To broaden visitor sources, the authorities will actively attract international tourists by setting up overseas offices under the Macao Government Tourism Office (MGTO) and organizing promotional events alongside the Chief Executive’s official visits. Regarding gaming regulation, lawmaker Chan Hao Weng noted that fierce competition among the six integrated resort operators has led to “involution,” with operators continuously raising commissions to attract customers, resulting in high operating costs and shrinking profit margins. Ng responded unequivocally that both the SAR Government and the six concessionaires share the core objective of promoting the healthy and orderly development of the gaming industry. If the practice of raising commissions to poach customers is found to be true, the authorities will strictly handle the matter, though time is needed to investigate the actual situation. Additionally, she reiterated that the government will continue to urge concessionaires next year to faithfully fulfill their concession contracts and accelerate major construction and non-gaming investments. As for the gaming equipment industry, Acting Director of the Gaming Inspection and Coordination Bureau (DICJ) Lio Chi Chong added during the session that all casino gaming equipment is strictly regulated and must comply with relevant laws. Given that equipment manufacturing involves information technology and other technical fields, the authorities maintain an open attitude toward the local manufacturing, supply, and export of gaming equipment, viewing it as beneficial to industrial development, and will coordinate with relevant departments to provide appropriate assistance if enterprises express demand. Establishing a Dedicated Procurement Matching Mechanism and Leveraging the 10th Anniversary of “Creative City of Gastronomy” to Drive SME Transformation Addressing lawmaker Ngan Iek Hang’s inquiry on the “large enterprises leading small enterprises” initiative, Director of the Economic and Technological Development Bureau (DSED) Yau Yun Wah revealed that the SME procurement program co-organized by the six integrated resort operators and local chambers of commerce since 2016 has yielded remarkable results. From 2023 to the first three quarters of 2026, cumulative procurement from local SMEs by the six operators exceeded MOP 50 billion, accounting for an average of about 33 percent of their total annual procurement. Ng stated that next year, the government will further encourage integrated resort operators to open up their supply chain resources and establish a dedicated procurement matching mechanism. Authorities will proactively collect procurement demands from the operators and precisely match them with local SME products and services to expand business opportunities. Meanwhile, as Macao celebrates the 10th anniversary of its designation as a UNESCO “Creative City of Gastronomy” next year, the government will launch a series of promotional activities to raise Macao’s profile. Ng urged local SMEs to seize these opportunities, adapt to evolving resident and visitor consumption patterns, leverage their unique strengths to innovate and embrace change, and continuously enhance product and service quality to achieve self-transformation and upgrading.

item.title: 澳門銀河打造冬日慶典 LADY DIOR夢幻裝置盡顯節日魅力
item.description:
>
7.5米高的「LADY DIOR夢幻裝置」由藝術家Sylvain Chomet設計。 今個冬季，澳門銀河以「銀河冬日閃耀時」為主題推出一系列慶典，攜手法國高級時裝品牌Dior呈獻華南地區唯一、亞洲僅五個展出地點之一的「LADY DIOR夢幻裝置」，串聯奢華購物、星級美饌與多元慶祝活動。 設於明珠大堂的「LADY DIOR夢幻裝置」由藝術家Sylvain Chomet設計，配上品牌經典Lady Dior手袋造型，將裝置構建成高達7.5米的華麗聖誕大宅，輔以節慶裝飾及靈動機械元素，盡顯法式優雅與節日魅力；毗鄰的7.5米高「DIOR聖誕樹」則由幸運星加冕，圍繞胡桃夾子與搖搖木馬等裝飾，專門店亦同步推出冬日獨家系列。 此外，澳門銀河旗下9間酒店均設有主題聖誕樹，包括萊佛士、大倉、銀河酒店及嘉佩樂等各具造型；翡翠大堂的巨型機械毛絨貓「閃耀星喵」亦換上聖誕新裝迎賓。 銀河時尚匯方面，Chaumet於時尚大道中打造8米高「皇家花園」聖誕樹及法式花園裝置；賓客消費滿額可參與「冬日閃耀禮」寶箱抽獎，並透過應用程式及「銀河賞」享專屬回贈。 美饌體驗同樣豐富，米芝蓮一星8½ Otto e Mezzo BOMBANA推出松露冬日七道菜及帝王蟹、藍龍蝦除夕盛宴；麗思酒廊聯乘Chaumet推出皇室瑰寶下午茶，CHA BEI亦供應聖誕松露雞肉撻、肉桂米布甸等限定下午茶。同時，小朋友可於在銀河參與獨家「童樂冬日閃耀尋寶」探索之旅；12月3、4及11日多間酒店將舉行兒童合唱團獻唱；東翼廣場設匯聚本地老字號及中小企的「冬日閃耀市集」，千里吧、長廊酒吧、麗思酒廊及安達仕酒吧亦將於跨年夜舉行慶祝活動迎新歲。

item.title: 澳門擬建休企採購對接機制 力爭2030年非博彩佔GDP六成
item.description:
>
吳惠嫻指當局將全力推動「1+4」產業適度多元發展。 澳門經濟財政司司長吳惠嫻周一(23日)列席立法會全體會議，與議員辯論明年經濟財政施政方針。多位議員關注澳門經濟適度多元發展及中小企支援政策。吳惠嫻表示，澳門政府力爭達成2030年非博彩業佔經濟總量六成的目標，強調這是博彩與非博彩業務同步增長；同時，明年將推動大型綜合旅遊休閒企業開放供應鏈資源，建立專屬採購對接機制，深化「以大帶小」以創造更多商業合作機會。此外，針對議員反映博企疑出現提高佣金搶客的「內卷」情況，她強調若屬實當局必定嚴格處理。 立法議員施家倫關注非博彩項目的高質量落地情況，以及博彩與非博彩業在經濟總量中的比例關係。吳惠嫻回應指，「三五」規劃的其中一項目標是讓非博彩業佔經濟總量達六成，這並非意味縮減博彩業總量，而是透過推動博彩與非博彩同步增長來實現。當局將善用會展商貿、現代金融、引導基金及科技研發產業園等舉措，全力推動「1+4」產業適度多元發展。 針對議員顏奕恆對「以大帶小」產業對接的關注，澳門經濟及科技發展局局長邱潤華指出，自2016年政府推動六家大型休企與澳門商會合辦中小企採購計劃以來，成效顯著。數據顯示，2023至2026年首三季期間，六大休企向澳門中小企的採購金額累計逾500億元，年均佔休企整體採購額約33%。他期望未來大型企業能進一步開放更多應用場景，為本地中小企及青年創業者提供供應鏈配對。 吳惠嫻補充，澳門政府一直針對不同發展階段的中小企提供支援，明年將進一步推動休企開放供應鏈資源，建立專屬的採購對接機制。屆時政府會主動收集休企的採購需求，再精準配對本地中小企的產品與服務，藉「以大帶小」模式拓寬商機。她同時指出，隨着市民及旅客的消費習慣與市場模式不斷轉變，澳門中小企亦需結合自身優勢，勇於創新並靈活求變，持續提升產品與服務質素；政府將與業界共同努力，創造更有利的營商與發展條件。 在博彩業監管與發展方面，議員陳孝永指出，六大休閒企業競爭激烈並出現「內卷」情況，為搶客不斷提高佣金，導致行業經營成本高、利潤持續攤薄。吳惠嫻回應表示，澳門政府與六間博企均以促進博彩業健康有序發展為核心目標，若上述情況屬實，當局必定嚴格處理，惟需時了解實際情況。 此外，博彩監察協調局代局長廖志聰在會上表示，澳門娛樂場內的博彩設備均受嚴格監管，必須符合相關法律法規；由於博彩設備製造涉及資訊科技等技術，當局對博彩設備的本地製造、供應以至出口持開放態度，認為有助產業發展，若企業有需求，會積極協調相關部門為業界提供適切協助。

item.title: 澳娛綜合德利賽車隊澳門大賽車奪1冠1亞 延續半世紀賽車傳奇
item.description:
>
澳娛綜合德利賽車隊在今屆澳門大賽車勇奪一冠一亞佳績。 作為第73屆澳門格蘭披治大賽車主要贊助商，澳娛綜合冠名贊助的德利賽車隊在今屆賽事再創輝煌。於11月22日正賽中，車隊車手中村紀庵於東望洋賽道勇奪國際汽聯FR世界盃冠軍，為車隊摘下歷來第11次澳門大賽車桂冠；隊友伊高斯(James Egozi)亦獲第4名。同日，隊中車手邦達列夫(Oleksandr Bondarev)亦在國際汽聯四級方程式世界盃中僅以0.542秒之差奪得亞軍。 車隊車手中村紀庵勇奪國際汽聯FR世界盃冠軍。 澳娛綜合常務董事何超鳳表示，大賽車已融入澳娛綜合的發展脈絡，第11冠延續了世代傳承的賽車精神。這份淵源始於已故德利賽車隊創辦人、「格蘭披治先生」葉德利，多年來澳娛綜合與車隊並肩同行，持續培育賽車人才，延續跨越半世紀的賽車傳奇。 賽場以外，澳娛綜合亦積極走進社區，於11月16日舉辦「極速傳奇」活動，安排逾百名本地中學生及大學生與車手交流並參觀賽事後勤區，推廣賽車文化。展望未來，澳娛綜合將繼續配合澳門政府建設「體育之城」的願景，引入多元國際體育盛事，推動「體育＋旅遊」融合及澳門經濟適度多元發展。

item.title: South Korean Police Bust Transnational Online Gambling Ring, Arresting 47
item.description:
>
South Korean Police Bust Transnational Online Gambling Ring, Arresting 47 Police in Jeju, South Korea, have smashed a transnational illegal online gambling syndicate based in Cambodia and Laos. The group is suspected of operating 13 illicit betting websites involving a total betting turnover of 800 billion won (approximately HK$4.675 billion). A total of 47 suspects were arrested, with 20 placed in detention. The Jeju Provincial Police Agency recently announced that between May 2022 and June this year, the syndicate set up offices in locations including Cambodia’s capital, Phnom Penh, to run illegal websites offering gambling games such as baccarat. As Cambodian authorities intensified crackdowns on criminal compounds, the group subsequently relocated its operational base to Laos. Police investigations revealed that the syndicate was primarily composed of acquaintances from the Jeju region—consisting of senior and junior peers—with a clear internal division of labor, including ringleaders, recruiters for “mule” bank accounts, and customer service staff responsible for soliciting members. The group attracted gamblers through online banner advertisements and various instant messaging apps. They accepted bank transfers or the stablecoin Tether (USDT) as wagers, converting the funds into virtual chips on the websites for members to participate in illegal gambling activities like baccarat. According to the police, the suspects used their illicit proceeds to fund extravagant lifestyles, including traveling overseas to watch football matches, gambling at local casinos, and purchasing luxury cars and high-end goods. During the arrest operations, police seized 1.2 billion won (approximately HK$7 million) in cash and jewelry valued at around 400 million won (approximately HK$2.35 million) at the scene. In addition, police identified approximately 5 billion won (approximately HK$29.2 million) in suspected criminal proceeds and implemented pre-indictment asset preservation measures—covering assets such as rental security deposits—to prevent the illicit funds from being transferred or disposed of.

item.title: Paradise Becomes South Korea’s First Foreigner-Only Casino to Obtain International Anti-Bribery and Compliance Certifications
item.description:
>
Paradise Becomes South Korea’s First Foreigner-Only Casino to Obtain International Anti-Bribery and Compliance Certifications South Korean foreigner-only casino operator Paradise Co., Ltd. announced on November 17 that it had obtained integrated certification for two international standards: the Anti-bribery Management System (ISO 37001) and the Compliance Management System (ISO 37301), becoming the first company in South Korea’s foreigner-only casino industry to achieve this dual certification. According to information recently released by Paradise Co., Ltd., the certifications were issued by the Korea Compliance Certification Institute, recognizing that the company’s anti-bribery and compliance management systems meet the relevant requirements of the International Organization for Standardization (ISO). ISO 37001 focuses primarily on the prevention and management of internal bribery risks within an enterprise, while ISO 37301 emphasizes management systems for ensuring compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and internal rules. To obtain the certification, Paradise Co., Ltd. established a unified management system across its headquarters and all operating properties. This included formulating anti-bribery and compliance management policies, assessing risks across various business operations, reviewing regulatory compliance, and refining risk assessment and management procedures. The company also revised its internal regulations and business processes, strengthening its overall corporate ethics and compliance framework through employee training, internal audits, and continuous improvement measures. Paradise Co., Ltd. noted that obtaining the integrated certification for these two international standards helps enhance corporate governance transparency, further advance Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives, and strengthen trust among stakeholders, including customers, business partners, and investors. Chief Executive Officer Jong-hwan Choi stated, “Moving forward, the company will continue to promote transparent and responsible corporate management so that a culture of compliance takes root throughout the entire organization, striving to grow into a sustainable enterprise trusted by all stakeholders.” Paradise Co., Ltd. added that it will continue to refine its prevention and management mechanisms for bribery and compliance risks while raising employees’ compliance awareness to further strengthen its ESG management and corporate governance standards.
